priorities.summary: iFlytek astron-agent before 1.1.2 defaults its workflow code-node path to an unsandboxed LocalExecutor that exposes full Python builtins. An authenticated low-privilege tenant can execute code as root in the core-workflow container and use shared credentials to read or modify other tenants' data.

Mage OSS through 0.9.80 proceeds with session creation when it encounters an unknown OAuth provider, a session-handling flaw that lets attackers establish sessions illegitimately. Public proof-of-concept exploit code is available, though it is not yet in the CISA KEV catalog.

Misaka Danmu Server through 2.8.9 has an authentication bypass in the unprotected POST /api/ui/config-history/rollback endpoint, letting unauthenticated attackers write arbitrary configuration keys. No public exploit is confirmed yet; patch and monitor.

model.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
model.summary: DeepSeek released a faster, leaner update to its V4.1 Flash open-weight model on Oct 17 with MIT-licensed weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope. It improves reasoning, coding, and agentic benchmarks while cutting per-task cost roughly 60% versus its predecessor, intensifying the open-weight race against US frontier labs.
